candidates.description: This feature vector is related to subword tokens and fragments commonly found in Hindi script and Devanagari text processing.
These tokens represent common dependent vowel signs, inflectional suffixes, and character fragments from the Devanagari script used in Hindi and related languages.
These Hindi text fragments and subword tokens represent common adverbial, pronominal, and relational roots across various North Indian languages.
This feature activates on Devanagari script characters and sub-word tokens.
This vector represents Hindi conditional, temporal, and interrogative conjunctions and adverbial roots.
This vector activates for common Hindi vowel suffix and inflectional endings.
This vector activates on a random assortment of unrelated subword tokens and non-standard characters lacking a cohesive semantic theme.
This vector represents common Hindi prefixes and root word fragments beginning with vowels and common consonants.
This feature vector activates strongly on common Hindi subword tokens and text fragments.
This feature vector represents Devanagari vowel and consonant-vowel matra combinations mixed with punctuation and formatting artifacts.
